card.title: 6th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 6th Infantry Regiment was attached to the 3rd Division, which was first formed in 1871 and was one of the oldest divisions of the Imperial Japanese Army. Prior to WWII the division participated in the First Sino-Japanese War, the Russo-Japanese War, the Siberian Intervention and the Shandong Incident and was considered a crack unit.
